items.title: Vince DiMartino interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 8, 2025
items.q: And Count Basie asked to see me. And I said, “Wow, I’d love to meet him.” So he says, “Wow, young man, you sound really good”

ctx.x: And they knew I could play. And after they heard me to play with Clark Terry because he asked me to play. That very first year that I played with him, that I was teaching. But the next year I wasn’t playing anything. They said, “How come you never play with us?” I said, “Well because you wouldn’t have a chance to play another solo, you know I like to feature one of you playing a solo, a saxophone, a trumpet, a trombone you know, and if we do that then there would be two trumpet solos and we don’t need that. We…

pretty good. And I played a solo with them. And Count Basie asked to see me. And I said, “Wow, I’d love to meet him.” So he says, “Wow, young man, you sound really good” he says, “you know if we have an opening on the Basie band, would you like to come and play lead trumpet with us?” I said, “Well you know I’d really love to do that but I can’t do it during the year because I really love what I’m doing here. But thanks for asking,” I said, “that’s a great thing” you know what I mean? So I’m happy just to get…
